request.unavailable: Huya data is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
request.limited: Huya is rate limiting requests. BN will retry after the cooldown.
request.verify: Huya requires sign-in or verification. Queries for all rooms are paused and will retry automatically.
request.storage: BN could not save the Huya cooldown state. Check BN storage.
profile.input: Enter a Huya room number, room link, or streamer name.
profile.missing: Huya could not find this room.
live.unknown: Huya did not return a confirmed live status.
live.restricted: Access to this Huya room is restricted.

$manifest.name: Huya
$manifest.description: Subscribe to start, ongoing, and end notifications for Huya streams.
